title: 第十六章 棺中锁魂
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
开棺两个字一出，梁家宗族立刻炸了。

    “不可！”

    “惊扰祖宗，这是大不孝！”

    “沈姑娘，你年纪轻，不能拿我梁家祖坟胡闹！”

    梁二叔站在人群中，脸色沉痛，竟真像个替亡兄守体面的好弟弟。

    “沈清萝，我大哥已经入土半年。你听一个女鬼几句话，就要开我大哥的棺？”

    他抬手指向主墓。

    “开棺惊祖，这个不孝的罪名，你担得起？”

    沈清萝从布包里取出玄司文书。

    “我担不起不孝。”

    她把文书展开。

    “我担得起玄司的章。”

    族老们一静。

    沈清萝一字一句道：“梁家祖坟闹煞，前有守墓人疯癫，后有小厮横死，坟底另压女魂，买地券断裂。按玄司墓籍条例，阴宅已成凶地，守墓人有权开棺验阴。”

    梁二叔咬牙：“玄司也不能大过宗族规矩！”

    “宗族规矩管活人脸面。玄司文书管死人有没有被害。”

    沈清萝看着他。

    “你们怕我开棺，是怕你三叔，还是怕里面那个人开口？”

    这句话一落，梁家几个族老脸色都变了。

    死人不会说话，活人才敢抢着替死人说。

    可若死人真开口呢？

    谢无咎站在沈清萝侧后方，没有替她说一个字。

    他只是站着。

    梁家家丁想上前，又被那股冷意逼得不敢动。

    梁二叔还想拖。

    他让人去请族谱，说要先告祖；又让人取香案，说开棺前需三拜九叩。

    沈清萝只说了一句：“可以。拖一刻，亡魂散一分。散了之后，梁大爷若成厉鬼，第一口咬谁，我不保证。”

    梁家人立刻安静了。

    孝道压人好用，厉鬼咬人更好用。

    最后，还是宋砚带着两个缚魂使动手。

    沈清萝站在墓门前，按规矩记录。

    “开墓时辰。”

    铁柱低头：“丑时三刻。”

    “在场人。”

    “梁氏、梁二叔、梁家族老七人、家丁十二人、清虚观方怀仁、玄司守墓人沈清萝、临时伙计谢无咎。”

    谢无咎冷冷看他。

    铁柱补了一句：“临时。”

    沈清萝低头咳了一声。

    棺木被抬出墓室时，梁家人跪了一地，哭声一片。

    沈清萝没被哭声带偏。

    她盯着棺盖缝隙。

    那里有一道细细的黑线，像血干后又被符火烤过。
content_en:
As soon as the word "open coffin" came out, the Liang family immediately exploded.

    "No!"

    "It is unfilial to disturb our ancestors!"

    "Miss Shen, you are too young to mess around with the ancestral graves of my Liang family!"

    Second Uncle Liang stood in the crowd with a sad face, really like a good brother who was trying to save his deceased brother's dignity.

    "Shen Qingluo, my eldest brother has been buried for half a year. Are you going to open my eldest brother's coffin after hearing a few words from a female ghost?"

    He raised his hand and pointed to the main tomb.

    "Opening the coffin to shock the ancestors, can you bear the charge of being unfilial?"

    Shen Qingluo took out Xuansi's documents from the cloth bag.

    "I can't afford to be unfilial."

    She unfolded the document.

    "I can afford Xuan Si's seal."

    The clan elders were silent.

    Shen Qingluo said word by word: "There was a disturbance in the Liang family's ancestral tomb. The tombkeeper went crazy in front of it, a young boy died violently in the back, a female soul was buried under the tomb, and the land purchase certificate was broken. According to Xuansi's tomb registration regulations, the tomb has become a dangerous place, and the tombkeeper has the right to open the coffin and examine the tomb."

    Second Uncle Liang gritted his teeth: "Xuan Si can't go beyond the clan rules!"

    "Clan rules govern the dignity of the living. Secretary Xuan governs whether the dead were harmed or not."

    Shen Qingluo looked at him.

    "Are you afraid that I will open the coffin, are you afraid of your third uncle, or are you afraid of the person inside opening the coffin?"

    As soon as these words were spoken, the faces of the elders of the Liang family changed.

    The dead cannot speak, but the living dare to speak for the dead.

    But what if the dead man really speaks?

    Xie Wujiu stood beside Shen Qingluo and didn't say a word for her.

    He just stood.

    The Liang family servant wanted to step forward, but was forced by the coldness to dare not move.

    Second Uncle Liang still wanted to delay.

    He asked someone to ask for the genealogy, saying that the ancestors must be informed first; he also asked people to get the incense case, saying that before opening the coffin, he needed to bow three times and knock nine times.

    Shen Qingluo only said: "Okay. If you wait a moment, the soul of the dead will be dispersed. After that, if Uncle Liang becomes a ghost, I can't guarantee who he will bite first."

    The Liang family immediately became quiet.

    Filial piety is more effective in suppressing people, but fierce ghosts are more effective in biting people.

    In the end, it was Song Yan who took the two soul-binding envoys to take action.

    Shen Qingluo stood in front of the tomb door and recorded according to the rules.

    "The time to open the tomb."

    Tie Zhu lowered his head: "There are three moments of ugliness."

    "People present."

    "Mr. Liang, Second Uncle Liang, seven elders of the Liang family, twelve servants, Qingxuguan Fang Huairen, Xuansi tombkeeper Shen Qingluo, and temporary clerk Xie Wujiu."

    Xie Wujiu looked at him coldly.

    Tie Zhu added: "Temporarily."

    Shen Qingluo lowered her head and coughed.

    When the coffin was carried out of the tomb, the Liang family knelt on the ground and cried.

    Shen Qingluo was not distracted by the cry.

    She stared at the gap in the coffin lid.

    There was a thin black line there, like dried blood that had been roasted by the talisman fire.
title_en: Chapter 16 The Soul Locked in the Coffin
